screen.title: Library
screen.search: Search your library · e.g. nickel prospectivity spatial cross-validation
screen.error: Could not read your library. Open it again in a moment.
screen.empty: Your library has no papers yet. Add the first one from a PDF or a DOI.

source.zoteroHint: This paper is in Zotero. Edit its reference details in Zotero.
source.gaidHint: This paper was added to the GAID library. You can edit it in GAID.

coverage.fullHint: Every page of the PDF was read.
coverage.partialHint: Some pages had no readable text: scanned pages or pages with figures only.
coverage.abstractHint: Only the abstract and reference details were read.
coverage.noneHint: There is no readable PDF. Add the PDF so GAID can read the full text.
coverage.retractedHint: Crossref or OpenAlex has a retraction record for this paper.

workflow.button: Make a Workflow from the paper

detail.usesEmpty: Not used in a note, Workflow or project yet.
detail.workflowNeedsPdf: To make a Workflow, GAID needs the paper's PDF.
detail.attachFailed: Could not attach to the project. Try again.

dialog.title: Add paper
dialog.body: Upload the PDF, check the reference details and add it to your library. A paper with only a DOI can be added too.
dialog.pdfFailed: Could not upload the PDF. Check that it is a PDF of 64 MB or less.
dialog.check: I checked that the reference details are correct
dialog.duplicate: A paper with the same DOI is already in your library.
dialog.failed: Could not add the paper. Check the details and try again.
dialog.candidates: Reference details found · choose the matching one

notes.pdf-no-text: No text could be read from the PDF. If it is a scan, search by DOI or title.
notes.no-doi: No DOI was found. Search by title or enter the details.
notes.provider-error: Some reference services did not respond.
notes.not-found: No matching reference details were found. Enter them yourself.

dialog.retracted: This paper has a retraction record. Check the retraction notice before adding it.
dialog.corrected: This paper has a correction record.
dialog.importDone: Added {added} papers. Skipped {duplicates} already in your library.
dialog.importFailed: Could not read the bibliography file. Check its format.

zotero.title: Zotero
zotero.webKeyHint: A read key made under Security in your zotero.org settings. GAID keeps it in the library settings only and never shows it again.

states.zotero-closed: Zotero is not running. Open Zotero and connect again.
states.local-api-off: In Zotero Settings → Advanced, turn on "Allow other applications to communicate", then connect again.
states.key-rejected: Zotero refused the connection. Check the key or the approval.
states.unreachable: Could not reach Zotero. Try again in a moment.

send.failed: Could not send to Zotero. Check the Zotero connection.
